variation: Seated machine calf raise with knee angle near90degrees, pads on lower thighs, forefeet on short step and heels free. Soleus emphasis.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter, entire seated machine and both feet visible.
equipment: Plate-loaded seated calf machine with one pivoting thigh-pad lever and fixed seat and step.
beats: Sit tall; lower heels below the step.
Raise heels; keep thighs against the pads.
Lift heels high against the thigh pads.
Pause briefly; keep both forefeet supported.
Let heels drop below the step gently.
